decision_conditions: The proposed use of the existing dwelling house as a children's care home for two children agreed 10-17 with a maximum of two staff present at all times if operated as described by the applicant in the supporting statement submitted would not be materially removed from the use of the property as a single dwelling house if operated as described and it is considered that there would be no material change of use having regard to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) as the use would remain within Class C3(a) of that Order.

This certificate of lawfulness is issued on the basis of the use as described - "Application for a certificate of lawfulness for the proposed use of the existing dwelling house as a children's care home for two children agreed 10-17 with a maximum of two staff present at all times".

It does not preclude against any action from being taken by the Council if it is later judged that a material change of use has occurred, should for example the intensity of the use go beyond what is described on the certificate issued or the character and nature of activities divulge from the supporting information submitted and the assessment made at this time.
description: Application for a certificate of lawfulness for the proposed use of the existing dwelling house as a children's care home for two children agreed 10-17 with a maximum of two staff present at all times
